description: This C# source file defines the class TestDirectoryCache, which implements the IGrainDirectoryCache interface. It acts as a wrapper around an internal cache, allowing operations like add, update, remove, and lookup of grain addresses and versions, and records each operation in a concurrent queue for testing or logging purposes.
